0x0007C4.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007F6.en: 「At my current level...@ this is my limit...!」

0x000867.en: 「Guh!@ So this is as far as I go...!!」

0x0008EF.en: 「Dammit!@ Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A50.en: 「Oh dear...@ how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000AC4.en: 「Nngh, so this is as far as I go!」

0x000B54.en: 「Not gonna blow it here...!@ This ain't fun...」

0x000BA8.en: 「Slipped up...!@ Guess I've got to bail...」

0x000C1C.en: 「Guh! Nothing to do but pull back!!」

0x000C92.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000CF9.en: 「This is my limit... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DA5.en: 「No good, I took too much damage... I'm retreating!」

0x000DF2.en: 「What a pain. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E30.en: 「Ah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E77.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F22.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x00101A.en: 「Well now, they've gone and got me!」

0x00105E.en: 「U...ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0010CB.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001112.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001147.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001233.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm still too green...!」

0x001281.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Pulling back!」

0x00133C.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00136B.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013A9.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0013D8.en: 「I can't go on any further. If you'll excuse me.」

0x001463.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll have to withdraw...!」

0x0015C9.en: 「Beginning evacuation...@　Kh...! Can't even go out in style...」

0x001687.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018CB.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x00193A.en: 「Colonel Lefina, word from the Kirkus army:@ Prince Feil has retaken Langran's capital...@ and Kirkus forces are winning on every front.」

0x001A21.en: 「So is that likely to decide the course of the war?」

0x001A64.en: 「No. The enemy seems to be massing its forces@　near the Ledna Gorge, and naturally,@　General Kirkus won't overlook that either...」

0x001B2D.en: 「The battle that decides Langran's fate@　is only just beginning.」

0x001B9C.en: 「If Prince Feil, the first in line to the throne,@　has retaken the capital, then Will in the@　Langran army should be rising, but...」

0x001C3E.en: 「How General Kirkus feels about it is another matter.」

0x001C8A.en: 「If the general wants Prince Terius on the throne,@　conflict with Prince Feil will be unavoidable.」

0x001D19.en: 「That said, Prince Terius doesn't seem@　the type to let himself be propped up so easily.」

0x001D87.en: 「It was General Kirkus who raised the banner of@　counterattack against Shutedonias. He surely takes@　pride in sparking Langran's liberation.」

0x001E44.en: 「And his army holds the greater strength...@　He may be planning to install Prince Terius,@　then build a new regime of his own.」

0x001F38.en: 「Invasion, then civil war. Good grief,@　people are the same no matter@　what world you're in.」

0x001FB9.en: 「...Yang Long,@　what do you intend to do?」

0x002009.en: 「I mean to meet General Kirkus directly@　and see his true intentions for myself.」

0x002071.en: 「And if I find that his actions will throw not just@　Langran but all of La Gias into chaos...」

0x0020FA.en: 「Then I must fulfill my duty@　as a Machine God pilot.」

0x002150.en: 「Masaki told me a little about it once,@　but this duty of a Machine God pilot...」

0x0021D0.en: 「In <La Gias>, a Machine God pilot@ doesn't have to obey any power at all.@ The judgment rests with the pilot himself.」

0x002277.en: 「And that duty is this...@　when the world faces the threat of ruin,@　to cast aside everything and stand against it.」

0x002372.en: 「By siding with Prince Feil, you mean?」

0x0023AC.en: 「That... I don't know.@　But first, I want to confirm the general's@　intentions directly.」

0x00243C.en: 「Also, there's a good chance he has information@　on the other members of the Steel Dragon Squadron.@　I'll check on the surface-return matter too.」

0x0024F3.en: 「Even if the Hagane were under Prince Feil,@　the general would surely hide that from us...」

0x00257C.en: 「In any case, the ones holding the key to our@　return to the surface are General Kirkus and Prince Feil, yes?」

0x002615.en: 「Then we need to confirm their intentions as well.@　Starting with General Kirkus...@　Yang Long, this ship will accompany you.」

0x0026E3.en: 「...Captain, a Kirkus army unit nearby@　seems to be engaged in combat with someone.」

0x00275A.en: 「Combat...?@　Could the Shutedonias army still be in this area?」

0x0027B3.en: 「Colonel Lefina,@　could you head that way?」

0x002809.en: 「Understood.@　All hands, battle stations, level one!」

0x00287F.en: 「You're the ones who struck first.@　Now then, prepare yourselves.」

0x0028D2.en: 「My, my. And here I wondered what had shown up.」

0x002941.en: 「Dr. Shirakawa and the Granzon...@　no, the Neo Granzon, back then...!」

0x0029DA.en: 「Leave this to us and fall back!」

0x002A6D.en: 「Judging from the energy readings,@　there's no mistaking it...」

0x002AC6.en: 「Is Shu Shirakawa the one piloting it?」

0x002B00.en: 「But he was supposed to have died in the <Shura Rebellion>!」

0x002B45.en: 「Faster to just ask him directly!@　Shu! Are you the one in the Granzon!?」

0x002BC9.en: 「...It seems you all@　know of me as well.」

0x002C25.en: 「Huh!? Quit playing dumb!@　Don't tell me you've forgotten us!」

0x002C8D.en: 「I'm sorry to say,@　but I have no memory of the past.」

0x002D4C.en: 「No, that Shu wouldn't tell a lie@　like that to fool us...」

0x002DAB.en: 「And before that...@　how did he even survive?」

0x002E36.en: 「How rude! He's the genuine Master!@　True, he did die once, but@　he's come back to life like this!」

0x002F4A.en: 「Why would Shu have something like that...?@　No, more to the point, how did he come back to life!?」

0x00300E.en: 「M-mmph mmph mmph mmph! Mmph mmph mmph!@　(M-Master, please don't grab me!)」

0x00309A.en: 「Lord Shu, I'll handle things here.@　Please go on ahead.」

0x00313A.en: 「I hadn't planned on fighting you all, but...@　I'll keep you company for a little while.」

0x0031CD.en: 「I'm Saphine...@　Saphine Zeora Volkruss.@　Some call me Saphine of the Crimson Lotus.」

0x003263.en: 「Volkruss...?@　Then you're connected to that Louzorl...」

0x0032B9.en: 「Yes, Saphine is a Volkruss worshipper too.」

0x003390.en: 「Saphine, were you and Louzorl the ones@　who brought Shu back?」

0x00340B.en: 「What are you and that man trying to pull off!?」

0x003454.en: 「Oh, I could teach you all sorts of§@　naughty little things, but broad daylight might be a bad idea.」

0x003507.en: 「Princess Shine, you mustn't take@　what she says at face value.」

0x003560.en: 「My, still so stiff as ever, Yang Long.@　Well, stiff beats soft, I suppose§」

0x0035D3.en: 「Is that bitch making fun of us!?」

0x003604.en: 「Now come here, my little kittens.@　Mew for me nice and sweet, hm?」

0x003660.en: 「Looks like we'll be fighting after all, Yang Long.」

0x0036A6.en: 「We're square now, so... I won't hold back!」

0x0036EF.en: 「I don't know who you are... but stand in my way, and I'll shoot you through.」

0x0037D0.en: 「Ooh, that look in your eyes, that tension...!@　It gives me chills§」

0x003853.en: 「If you're Shu's underling,@　I can't just let you slip by!」

0x0038AC.en: 「Underling? Hardly...@　I'm a servant who's given Lord Shu both body and soul§」

0x003904.en: 「Here I come, you sultry old hag!」

0x003929.en: 「Wh-who are you calling a hag!?@　We're not that far apart in age!」

0x003982.en: 「Th-that sex appeal and that chest... she's no ordinary woman!」

0x0039BC.en: 「Oh, what a cute little boy.@　I'll tease you to your heart's content§」

0x003A14.en: 「I-I might actually be looking forward to this...!」

0x003A48.en: 「...Ah, that was wonderful.@　Well then, let's meet again.」

0x003AA4.en: 「All enemy signals in the combat zone have vanished.」

0x003B13.en: 「I was just thinking there are all kinds of people in this world...」

0x003B59.en: 「Well, she's the opposite of you, Captain.@　You might do to take a page from her, a little.」

0x003C30.en: 「To think Shu was alive after all...」

0x003C61.en: 「Yeah... Maybe Louzorl or Saphine brought him back to life.」

0x003CC3.en: 「But why would he have lost his memory?」

0x003D1F.en: 「If Louzorl's mixed up in this, then Shu's after reviving Volkruss now, isn't he?」

0x003DC1.en: 「Yang Long, are we really okay leaving them be?」

0x003E04.en: 「Even if we gave chase, we've got no leads.@　If the spirit radar can't pick them up either...@　odds are they're using a concealment spell.」

0x003EAF.en: 「Shu and Saphine worry me, but@　for now, let's hurry to General Kirkus.」
